name: GM Product Variation Table For Woocommerce
author: theme funda

sections.description:
The Product Variation Table for WooCommerce plugin enables the display of product variations in a table format, enhancing the shopping experience by making it easier for customers to compare different variations and make purchases quickly.

Features

  • Display variations in a structured table format
  • Customizable table columns (price, stock status, attributes, etc.)
  • Add to cart functionality directly from the table
  • Sorting and filtering options
  • Responsive design
  • Compatible with most WooCommerce themes
